name: autosprite
description: Turn one character image into a finished, engine-ready sprite sheet. Vision rigs the character into parts and joints, a deterministic skeletal animator draws idle/walk/run/jump/attack and 8-direction movement from those parts, and the sheet exports to Unity, Godot, Phaser, GameMaker, RPG Maker and Unreal with every output frame provably built from the source's own palette.
